scope: Offline-only pre-GPU scientific-validity review; no Modal, cloud, CUDA, GPU, commit, or tag operation was performed.

fresh_attempt_requirement.reason: Attempt b already has immutable invalid evidence. Reusing its identity would mix the 65-request pre-reclaim failure with the retry and collide with immutable remote publication.
fresh_attempt_requirement.outer_manifest_rule: The attempt-c config seals a post-fix outer manifest; that manifest must hash-bind Agents 1-8, current source/tests, and fresh make-check evidence without self-hash cycles.

scientific_contract.cross_process_clock_basis: time.monotonic_ns in two child processes of one Modal function/container; Linux monotonic time is host-wide and directly comparable across those processes
scientific_contract.movement_validation: Every canonical pass ID is unique, belongs to capture or restore, lies within its measured chain, and physical_touch_bytes sum exactly to integrated full_physical_bytes; reported amplification ratios are recomputed from integrated logical bytes.

changes_made: Fresh attempt-c authorization now accepts attempt b only as a hash-bound invalid pre-reclaim predecessor with provider cleanup PASS, verified remote manifest, zero active ledger reservations, and ledger continuity.
Attempt-c admission now requires an outer hash-sealed PASS set for all eight pre-GPU roles plus fresh make-check evidence; loaded evidence agent/role identities are checked against outer bindings.
The integrated source/test binding set now includes the early-trigger overlay and both trigger tests.
Remote packaging now includes v11-final evidence and attempt-b postflight cleanup instead of attempt-a cleanup.
Controller scientific validation now rejects missing, contradictory, noncausal, or arithmetically inconsistent decisive integrated evidence.
launch_blockers_remaining: The standardized Agent 1/3/5/8 evidence wrappers, this Agent 6 hash, and fresh make-check evidence must be assembled into the outer attempt-c manifest after all reviews finish.
The attempt-c config and one atomic ledger reservation must be created only after the outer manifest is sealed.
The full repository make check was intentionally left to the root coordinator because concurrent offline fixes were still landing; attempt-c admission rejects a missing or stale make-check artifact.

test_results.deselection_reason: The functional image-layout test requires the root-owned fresh make-check artifact, which did not yet exist during this independent review.

test_results.command: ruff check integrated controller/launcher and their tests
git diff --check on Agent 6 edited sources/tests
